Apple, Broccoli and Walnut Salad
By: Matt
Published: Sunday, October 22, 2017 - 4:32pm

Ingredients




For the salad
2 large apple (chopped)
6 1⁄4 oz broccoli (chopped)
1 3⁄4 oz walnut halves
For the dressing
1 dash black pepper
1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil
1⁄2 lemon (juice only)
1 dash salt

Preparation

1 Steam or boil the broccoli for 5-7 minutes 2 Place the broccoli in bowls, then the apple and walnut pieces. 3 In a small bowl mix the dressing ingredients. 4 Pour the dressing over the salad and serve.
